- [Forms](https://design.holistics.dev/guides/forms.md): A guide to building forms with Holistics components.

### Components

- [Accordion](https://design.holistics.dev/components/accordion.md): Expand and collapse sections of content.
- [Alert](https://design.holistics.dev/components/alert.md): Display important messages to the user, such as warnings, errors, success messages, or informational notices.
- [Avatar](https://design.holistics.dev/components/avatar.md): Display the user's profile image or show user initials in a circular shape when no image is available.
- [Avatar Group](https://design.holistics.dev/components/avatar_group.md): Display a group of avatar images, often representing users.
- [Badge](https://design.holistics.dev/components/badge.md): A little (clickable) box containing some texts
- [Banner](https://design.holistics.dev/components/banner.md): A conatiner including some info, warnings, errors or success messages.
- [Breadcrumb](https://design.holistics.dev/components/breadcrumb.md): A list of links that indicate the current page's location within a navigational hierarchy.
- [Button](https://design.holistics.dev/components/button.md): An element used to initiate actions or trigger events.
- [Checkbox](https://design.holistics.dev/components/checkbox.md): Select one or more options from a set.
- [Code Block](https://design.holistics.dev/components/code-block.md): A component for displaying syntax-highlighted code with optional line numbers and copy functionality
- [Collapsible Section](https://design.holistics.dev/components/collapsible-section.md): An interactive component which expands/collapses a panel.
- [Copy Box](https://design.holistics.dev/components/copy-box.md): Compose read-only text box & Copy button into Copy box
- [Copy Button](https://design.holistics.dev/components/copy-button.md): Can add copied indicator
- [Drawer](https://design.holistics.dev/components/drawer.md): Used to render content that slides in from the side of the screen
- [Divider](https://design.holistics.dev/components/divider.md): Creates separation between two UI elements to establish hierarchy and grouping
- [Dropdown](https://design.holistics.dev/components/dropdown.md): Allow users to choose one option from a floating list.
- [Field](https://design.holistics.dev/components/field.md): A component that provides labeling and validation for form controls.
- [File Drop Zone](https://design.holistics.dev/components/file-drop-zone.md)
- [Form](https://design.holistics.dev/components/form.md): A form component which allows users to input data.
- [Hero Banner](https://design.holistics.dev/components/hero-banner.md): Used to highlight important information on a page
- [Hotspot](https://design.holistics.dev/components/hotspot.md): An animated component that aims to draw a user’s attention to a specific area or spot on the screen
- [Modal](https://design.holistics.dev/components/modal.md): A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window.
- [Pagination](https://design.holistics.dev/components/pagination.md): Display clickable page numbers with the current page highlighted.
- [Popover](https://design.holistics.dev/components/popover.md): A rich floating element displayed on user interaction (click, hover, manual)
- [Popover (Onboarding)](https://design.holistics.dev/components/popover-onboarding.md): A Popover designed specifically for onboarding purposes
- [Progress Bar](https://design.holistics.dev/components/progress-bar.md): Visually communicates the completion status of a process or usage
- [Radio](https://design.holistics.dev/components/radio.md): Radio buttons require users to make one selection from a group of options that are mutually exclusive.
- [Segmented Control](https://design.holistics.dev/components/segmented-control.md): Toggle buttons for switching between different values or views
- [Select](https://design.holistics.dev/components/select.md): Allow users to choose one or more options from a dropdown list.
- [Shortcut](https://design.holistics.dev/components/shortcut.md): Indicate a shortcut for the user
- [Split Button](https://design.holistics.dev/components/split_button.md): A container of 1 primary button and 1 secondary button that can open a Dropdown
- [Switch](https://design.holistics.dev/components/switch.md): Allow users to toggle between two states: on and off.
- [Tab](https://design.holistics.dev/components/tab.md): A versatile component for organizing content into tabbed sections. It supports switching between views, navigation via links , and integration with routing for dynamic content rendering.
- [Tag](https://design.holistics.dev/components/tag.md): A little box containing some texts and a close button
- [Tag Input](https://design.holistics.dev/components/tag_input.md): An input that allows adding and removing tags
- [Tag List](https://design.holistics.dev/components/tag_list.md): A dynamic list of tags shows a remaining counter if all tags cannot be shown in 1 line
- [Table](https://design.holistics.dev/components/table.md): Display tabular data with sorting, filtering, and pagination powered by AgGrid.
- [Text Area](https://design.holistics.dev/components/text-area.md): A free-form text field that allows users to enter a sizeable amount of text, for example, descriptions or notes
- [Text Highlight](https://design.holistics.dev/components/text_highlight.md): Allow users to toggle between two states: on and off.
- [Text Input](https://design.holistics.dev/components/text-input.md): A single-line text field is used to allow the users to input some text
- [Tooltip](https://design.holistics.dev/components/tooltip.md): A floating element containing simple and concise texts displayed on hover
- [Tree](https://design.holistics.dev/components/tree.md): A tree view displays hierarchical list of items.
